dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires all paired claims within the selected disjunct to hold simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation from a division-and-inversion monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real division used to divide each coefficient and the threshold by the square root of the sum of coefficient squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality of two objects of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the scalar equalities for the squared norms and the extensional equalities between event sets.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite sum of a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the sum of coefficient squares, the original weighted sum, the normalized squared norm, and the normalized weighted sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes every displayed finite sum range over all indices in the finite type ι.

dependency_coverage.name: Fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type-class structure exhibiting a type as finite.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts the index type ι to be finite and makes summation over all its elements available; it does not require ι to be nonempty.

dependency_coverage.name: GE.ge
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reverse notation for the underlying less-than-or-equal relation: GE.ge x y means y ≤ x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns the predicates in the event sets into lower-tail inequalities of the form weighted sum ≥ threshold, and makes GE.ge 0 t mean 0 ≥ t.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Heterogeneous division supplied by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Computes a_i divided by the square-root normalization factor and t divided by that same factor.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Heterogeneous multiplication supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Multiplies each original or normalized real coefficient by the corresponding real value X i ω.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Heterogeneous exponentiation supplied by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Squares the original coefficients and the normalized coefficients using natural exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: States the hypothesis 0 ≤ t and underlies every non-strict real comparison in the event predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict less-than relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: States that the sum of coefficient squares is strictly positive in the normalization branch.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides natural-number powers from a monoid's repeated multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the standard natural power operation used to interpret each real square.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Serves as the exponent type, in particular for the exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a type equipped with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the literals 0, 1, and 2 occurring in comparisons, equalities, and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the numeral 1 using a type's distinguished multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the real value 1 in the assertion that the normalized coefficients have squared norm one.

dependency_coverage.name: Or
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical disjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the alternative between the zero-squared-norm case and the strictly-positive-squared-norm normalization case.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers used for coefficients, function values, thresholds, arithmetic, square roots, and order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes all numerical quantities in the proposition to real arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real addition and zero for every finite sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-number multiplication, inversion, integer-power, and division structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the standard real division used in both coefficient and threshold normalization.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard non-strict order relation on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets 0 ≤ t and all event inequalities as ordinary real inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order relation on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets 0 < Σ_i a_i² as strict positivity of the squared norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies repeated real multiplication for natural powers, so exponent 2 denotes squaring.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplication operation on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets each product a_i X_i(ω) and each corresponding product with a normalized coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished real multiplicative identity 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the right-hand side of the unit-squared-norm equality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished real additive identity 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the nonnegative-threshold hypothesis, the zero-squared-norm equality, the positivity test, and the constant-zero event predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to S = Σ_i a_i² to produce the normalization factor √S used in the positive branch.

dependency_coverage.name: Set
dependency_coverage.meaning: A set of elements of a type, represented as a predicate on that type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the threshold events subsets of Ω and allows the proposition to assert exact equality of those subsets.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the numeral 0 using a type's distinguished zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the real zero occurring in the hypothesis, branch condition, and constant event predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a homogeneous division operation on a type to an HDiv operation with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the real quotients a_i/√S and t/√S in the elaborated expression use ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a homogeneous multiplication operation on a type to an HMul operation with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes all displayed coefficient-function products ordinary real products.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a homogeneous power operation to an HPow operation returning the base type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes powers of real coefficients by natural exponent 2 ordinary real squares.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets each natural-number literal as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the exponent literal 2 denote the natural number two.

dependency_coverage.name: setOf
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs the set of all elements satisfying a predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the original, constant-zero, and normalized threshold-event subsets of Ω.

binders: An arbitrary finite index type ι, which may be empty.
An arbitrary family X assigning to each i ∈ ι a real-valued function X_i : Ω → ℝ.
An arbitrary real coefficient family a = (a_i) indexed by ι.
conclusions: Either S = Σ_{i∈ι} a_i² is zero and the set {ω ∈ Ω | Σ_{i∈ι} a_i X_i(ω) ≥ t} equals the set {ω ∈ Ω | 0 ≥ t}.
Or S is strictly positive, the normalized coefficients b_i = a_i/√S satisfy Σ_{i∈ι} b_i² = 1, and {ω ∈ Ω | Σ_{i∈ι} a_i X_i(ω) ≥ t} equals {ω ∈ Ω | Σ_{i∈ι} b_i X_i(ω) ≥ t/√S}.
mathematical_definitions: When S > 0, c := √S and b_i := a_i/c.
The original threshold event is E := {ω ∈ Ω | Σ_{i∈ι} a_i X_i(ω) ≥ t}.
The zero-case comparison event is E₀ := {ω ∈ Ω | 0 ≥ t}.
When S > 0, the normalized threshold event is E_norm := {ω ∈ Ω | Σ_{i∈ι} b_i X_i(ω) ≥ t/c}.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every finite real coefficient family, every family of real-valued functions on an arbitrary domain, and every nonnegative threshold, the proposition splits according to the squared Euclidean norm S of the coefficients. If S is zero, the original threshold event is exactly the event for the constant value zero. If S is positive, division of every coefficient and the threshold by √S produces coefficients of squared norm one and leaves the threshold event unchanged as a subset of Ω.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The index type is finite but is not required to be nonempty; for an empty index type, all sums are zero and only the zero branch can hold.
The domain Ω is arbitrary and may be empty; if Ω is empty, every asserted equality of event sets is vacuous, although the scalar norm equalities remain substantive.
The threshold is restricted to t ≥ 0; the proposition makes no claim for negative thresholds.
No measurability, probability measure, distribution, independence, moment, or tail assumptions are imposed on the functions X_i.
The conclusion concerns exact equality of subsets of Ω, not equality of probabilities or a probabilistic bound.
The zero branch explicitly asserts S = 0 and an event-set equality; it does not explicitly state coordinatewise that every a_i is zero.
Normalization is asserted only in the branch S > 0, where √S is positive, so that branch does not divide by zero.
When t = 0, the set {ω | 0 ≥ t} is all of Ω; when t > 0, it is empty.
The proposition does not identify a chosen disjunct by data beyond the displayed disjunction, even though S is a sum of real squares.
